name: g53_mustpressure
purpose: Pressure and mustpressure (Forretress, Male, Spikes on the foes side; Indeedee-F, Female, Imprison): Spikes costs one PP per standing Pressure foe on top of its own PP (two foes, two extras), and Imprison, a mustpressure move, costs the same two extras (every standing foe counts, whatever the move aims at); the foes then Protect, which Imprison bars, so the Aerodactyl that cannot use its Protect Struggles (no PP, no charge).
